analysis:
Examined the supplied batch analysis, replayed submodule metadata/patch, and selected canonical T-041 detail against the threat-model index. libs/mlx-swift-lm:1 advances the dependency commit, but no dependency implementation is supplied. The reported docs/reference/configuration.md:313 change describes default-on fused causal SDPA for eligible prefill chunks, packed-paged exclusion and a process-latched rollback; that documentation source is omitted from replay, so these claims cannot be independently verified here. No concrete security regression is established by the visible commit-pointer change alone.
Material review remains necessary for the dependency diff, particularly the reported Libraries/MLXLMCommon/ContinuousBatchingV2/AttentionV1.swift path: verify causal masking with cached prefixes and chunk offsets, KV-backend eligibility, output equivalence (T-007/TB-007), transient memory bounds and cancellation (T-010), and cache scope/state preservation (A-001, T-028, T-041). Confirm whether other dependency changes affect fail-closed encryption, authorization or media handling (T-008, T-053, T-050). The apparent resident-cache documentation mismatch with T-041's SSD-only production contract is reported as unchanged; it is not independently supported as PR-introduced drift. Replay omits two reviewed source units, and the dependency diff is absent, leaving the PR's native-runtime security effects unresolved rather than cleared.
